test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 22 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

P + Q means ‘P is the father of Q’,

P # Q means ‘P is the wife of Q’,

P & Q means ‘P is the brother of Q’,

and P % Q means ‘P is the sister of Q’.

How is O related to L if ‘O # G + N # T + L’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dfb6e3f018b907595a9b039f1a253885a593377be7cb0b376148a31f66a01c25.png] 

**Given:**

→ P + Q means P is the father of Q

→ P # Q means P is the wife of Q

→ P & Q means P is the brother of Q

→ P % Q means P is the sister of Q

**Expression:**

O # G + N # T + L
